definitions.gloss: a team of trained personnel organized to rescue people in emergencies such as disasters, mountain accidents, or maritime incidents
definitions.explanation: A group of trained rescuers — firefighters, coast guard members, mountain rescuers, or military personnel — dispatched to save lives in emergencies. Common compounds specify the context: {山岳|さんがく}{救助隊|きゅうじょたい} (mountain rescue), {海上|かいじょう}{救助隊|きゅうじょたい} (sea rescue), {災害|さいがい}{救助隊|きゅうじょたい} (disaster rescue).

examples.japanese: {救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{遭難者|そうなんしゃ}→遭難者：27894_sounansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: The rescue team found the people in distress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山岳|さんがく}→山岳：12522_sangaku⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The mountain rescue team headed to the scene by helicopter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rescue teams from various countries were dispatched to the earthquake-stricken area.

notes:
A collective noun for a trained team that responds to emergencies and saves lives. Regularly appears in news reports of disasters, accidents, and missing-person cases.

USAGE:
- Often prefixed to specify the domain: ⟦{山岳|さんがく}→山岳：12522_sangaku⟧・⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧・⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧・⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}.
- Individual members are {救助隊員|きゅうじょたいいん}.
- Activities performed by such a team are ⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (rescue operations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch a rescue team
- {救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the rescue team is deployed
- {救助隊|きゅうじょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the rescue team arrives
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}: international rescue team
- ⟦{山岳|さんがく}→山岳：12522_sangaku⟧{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}: mountain rescue team

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}→救急隊：26173_kyuukyuutai⟧: ambulance team, paramedic team — focused on emergency medical response, usually affiliated with fire departments.
- ⟦{消防隊|しょうぼうたい}→消防隊：29848_shouboutai⟧: firefighting team — specialized in extinguishing fires, but may also perform rescues.
- レスキュー⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧: rescue team (loan-word version) — common in casual and media contexts, roughly interchangeable with {救助隊|きゅうじょたい}.
